name: Gladys Ganda
detail: Spoke on tax equity stating 'those who have more must contribute more', but made no specific reference to net wealth taxation.

name: Top 40% PAYE Income Tax Band
detail: Progressive income tax band on monthly earnings above K10 million enacted by Parliament; targets income rather than stock of wealth.

name: Estate Duty Act
detail: Inheritance tax on deceased estates (up to 11%); excluded under Section 2.

name: Minimum Alternative Tax (MAT)
detail: Turnover-based corporate levy; corporate taxation is excluded under Section 2.

name: Mobile Money Transfer Levy
detail: Financial transaction levy; excluded under Section 2.

name: Goodall Gondwe
detail: Former Minister of Finance; passed away in August 2023.

name: Saulos Chilima
detail: Former Vice President and UTM founder; passed away in June 2024.

name: Rev Alemekezeke Chikondi Phiri
detail: Malawi Council of Churches General Secretary; campaigned against mining tax incentives and tax avoidance as part of the ecumenical ZacTax campaign, but made no specific call for net wealth taxation.

name: Thomas Munthali
detail: Former Director General of National Planning Commission; public commentary focuses on national wealth creation and GDP growth under Vision 2063 rather than wealth taxation.

name: Ben Kaluwa
detail: Prominent Professor of Economics at University of Malawi (UNIMA); passed away in July 2022.

name: Afrobarometer Round 8 Taxation Question
detail: Surveyed whether it is fair to tax rich people at a higher rate than ordinary people; asks about progressive tax rates generally, not an annual net wealth tax.
